title: Kudos to Municipal Sanitation Team for Prompt Drain Clearing!
body: Heartfelt thanks to the Poojappura ward sanitation workers who cleared the blocked culvert near Mandapam within 4 hours of our Nivara voice report. Water flowed freely during yesterday's evening showers!

title: Caution: Slippery Algae on Melarannoor Footbridge
body: Please be careful while crossing the pedestrian steps of Melarannoor overbridge after evening rains. Dense algae growth makes the surface extremely slippery for elderly citizens.

title: Neighbourhood Watch Alert: Suspicious Activity near Estate Road
body: Two-wheeler riders please note that the rear street of Pappanamcode Industrial Estate has 3 street lights out. Residents are advised to use the main highway route after 9 PM.
